standard.name: ISO 27001
standard.description: Information Security Management Systems - Requirements with Annex A Controls

categories.name: Organizational Controls
categories.description: Leadership, governance, and strategic aspects of information security (37 controls)

categories.name: People Controls
categories.description: Human resources security and cybersecurity culture (8 controls)

categories.name: Physical Controls
categories.description: Physical protection of IT assets (14 controls)

categories.name: Technological Controls
categories.description: System, application, and network defenses (34 controls)

clauses.title: Policies for information security
clauses.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur
clauses.helpText: Review documented information security policies covering all aspects of ISMS

clauses.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
clauses.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs
clauses.helpText: Check role definitions, responsibility matrices, and accountability assignment

clauses.title: Segregation of duties
clauses.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated
clauses.helpText: Verify separation of duties to reduce risk of unauthorized or unintentional modification

clauses.title: Management responsibilities
clauses.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization
clauses.helpText: Evidence of management support and enforcement of information security

clauses.title: Contact with authorities
clauses.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities
clauses.helpText: List of authorities and contact points (law enforcement, regulatory bodies, etc.)

clauses.title: Contact with special interest groups
clauses.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations
clauses.helpText: Membership in security groups, forums, and information sharing arrangements

clauses.title: Threat intelligence
clauses.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence
clauses.helpText: Threat intelligence sources, collection process, and analysis methods

clauses.title: Information security in project management
clauses.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management
clauses.helpText: Project management methodology includes information security considerations

clauses.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
clauses.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained
clauses.helpText: Asset inventory with classifications, owners, and locations

clauses.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
clauses.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented
clauses.helpText: Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) for information assets and technology

clauses.title: Return of assets
clauses.description: Personnel and external parties shall return all of the organization's assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement
clauses.helpText: Asset return process integrated into offboarding procedures

clauses.title: Classification of information
clauses.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements
clauses.helpText: Information classification scheme and handling requirements for each level

clauses.title: Labelling of information
clauses.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization
clauses.helpText: Labeling procedures for documents, emails, and data

clauses.title: Information transfer
clauses.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties
clauses.helpText: Secure transfer methods, encryption requirements, and agreements

clauses.title: Access control
clauses.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements
clauses.helpText: Access control policy covering both physical and logical access

clauses.title: Identity management
clauses.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed
clauses.helpText: Identity provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning processes

clauses.title: Authentication information
clauses.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information
clauses.helpText: Password policy, MFA requirements, and credential management

clauses.title: Access rights
clauses.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control
clauses.helpText: Access rights review process and role-based access control (RBAC)

clauses.title: Information security in supplier relationships
clauses.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services
clauses.helpText: Supplier risk assessment and information security requirements in procurement

clauses.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
clauses.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship
clauses.helpText: Contractual security requirements, SLAs, and right to audit clauses

clauses.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
clauses.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain
clauses.helpText: Supply chain risk management for ICT products and services

clauses.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
clauses.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery
clauses.helpText: Supplier performance monitoring and change management process

clauses.title: Information security for use of cloud services
clauses.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements
clauses.helpText: Cloud security policy, vendor assessment, and data management in cloud

clauses.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
clauses.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities
clauses.helpText: Incident response plan, roles, procedures, and communication plan

clauses.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
clauses.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents
clauses.helpText: Event classification criteria and escalation procedures

clauses.title: Response to information security incidents
clauses.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures
clauses.helpText: Incident response procedures, containment, eradication, and recovery

clauses.title: Learning from information security incidents
clauses.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls
clauses.helpText: Post-incident review process and lessons learned documentation

clauses.title: Collection of evidence
clauses.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events
clauses.helpText: Digital forensics procedures and chain of custody

clauses.title: Information security during disruption
clauses.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption
clauses.helpText: Business continuity plan with information security considerations

clauses.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
clauses.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements
clauses.helpText: Disaster recovery plan, backup/restore procedures, and testing results

clauses.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
clauses.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date
clauses.helpText: Register of applicable laws and regulations (GDPR, PCI-DSS, etc.)

clauses.title: Intellectual property rights
clauses.description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights
clauses.helpText: IP protection procedures, software licensing compliance

clauses.title: Protection of records
clauses.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release
clauses.helpText: Records management policy and retention schedule

clauses.title: Privacy and protection of PII
clauses.description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements
clauses.helpText: Privacy policy, data protection impact assessments (DPIA), consent management

clauses.title: Independent review of information security
clauses.description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur
clauses.helpText: Internal audit program and independent security assessments

clauses.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
clauses.description: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed
clauses.helpText: Compliance monitoring and reporting mechanisms

clauses.title: Documented operating procedures
clauses.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them
clauses.helpText: Standard operating procedures (SOPs) for IT operations

clauses.title: Screening
clauses.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks
clauses.helpText: Background check procedures for employees and contractors

clauses.title: Terms and conditions of employment
clauses.description: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security
clauses.helpText: Employment contracts with security responsibilities and NDAs

clauses.title: Information security awareness, education and training
clauses.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function
clauses.helpText: Security awareness program, training records, and phishing simulations

clauses.title: Disciplinary process
clauses.description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation
clauses.helpText: Disciplinary procedures for security violations

clauses.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
clauses.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties
clauses.helpText: Offboarding procedures with security checklist

clauses.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
clauses.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties
clauses.helpText: NDA templates and signed agreements for employees, contractors, partners

clauses.title: Remote working
clauses.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises
clauses.helpText: Remote work policy, VPN requirements, and secure remote access

clauses.title: Information security event reporting
clauses.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner
clauses.helpText: Incident reporting channels and procedures

clauses.title: Physical security perimeters
clauses.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets
clauses.helpText: Physical boundaries, fences, walls, and security zones

clauses.title: Physical entry
clauses.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points
clauses.helpText: Access control systems, badge readers, visitor management

clauses.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
clauses.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented
clauses.helpText: Secure areas for servers, telecommunications, and sensitive operations

clauses.title: Physical security monitoring
clauses.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access
clauses.helpText: CCTV, security guards, alarm systems, and monitoring procedures

clauses.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
clauses.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented
clauses.helpText: Environmental controls: fire suppression, climate control, flood protection

clauses.title: Working in secure areas
clauses.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented
clauses.helpText: Secure area access procedures and supervision requirements

clauses.title: Clear desk and clear screen
clauses.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced
clauses.helpText: Clean desk policy and screen lock requirements

clauses.title: Equipment siting and protection
clauses.description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected
clauses.helpText: Equipment placement to minimize environmental risks and unauthorized access

clauses.title: Security of assets off-premises
clauses.description: Off-site assets shall be protected
clauses.helpText: Controls for laptops, mobile devices, and data taken off-site

clauses.title: Storage media
clauses.description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements
clauses.helpText: Media handling, labelling, and secure disposal procedures

clauses.title: Supporting utilities
clauses.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities
clauses.helpText: UPS, backup generators, redundant power supplies

clauses.title: Cabling security
clauses.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage
clauses.helpText: Protected cable runs, conduits, and segregation of cables

clauses.title: Equipment maintenance
clauses.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information
clauses.helpText: Maintenance schedules, authorized service providers, and data protection during maintenance

clauses.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
clauses.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use
clauses.helpText: Data sanitization procedures and physical destruction of media

clauses.title: User endpoint devices
clauses.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected
clauses.helpText: Endpoint protection: antivirus, encryption, mobile device management (MDM)

clauses.title: Privileged access rights
clauses.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed
clauses.helpText: Privileged access management (PAM), principle of least privilege

clauses.title: Information access restriction
clauses.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control
clauses.helpText: Access control lists (ACLs), file permissions, database access controls

clauses.title: Access to source code
clauses.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed
clauses.helpText: Source code repository access controls and version control

clauses.title: Secure authentication
clauses.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control
clauses.helpText: Multi-factor authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, SSO

clauses.title: Capacity management
clauses.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements
clauses.helpText: Capacity planning and resource utilization monitoring

clauses.title: Protection against malware
clauses.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness
clauses.helpText: Antivirus, anti-malware, EDR solutions, and user training

clauses.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
clauses.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken
clauses.helpText: Vulnerability management program, scanning, and patch management

clauses.title: Configuration management
clauses.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed
clauses.helpText: Configuration management database (CMDB), baseline configurations, hardening

clauses.title: Information deletion
clauses.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required
clauses.helpText: Data retention policy and secure deletion procedures

clauses.title: Data masking
clauses.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration
clauses.helpText: Data masking for non-production environments and PII protection

clauses.title: Data leakage prevention
clauses.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information
clauses.helpText: DLP solutions and policies to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration

clauses.title: Information backup
clauses.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup
clauses.helpText: Backup strategy (3-2-1 rule), backup testing, and recovery procedures

clauses.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
clauses.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements
clauses.helpText: High availability architecture, failover mechanisms, and redundancy testing

clauses.title: Logging
clauses.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed
clauses.helpText: Centralized logging, SIEM, log retention, and tamper protection

clauses.title: Monitoring activities
clauses.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents
clauses.helpText: Security monitoring, anomaly detection, and SOC operations

clauses.title: Clock synchronisation
clauses.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources
clauses.helpText: NTP configuration and time synchronization across systems

clauses.title: Use of privileged utility programs
clauses.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled
clauses.helpText: Privileged utility access controls and logging

clauses.title: Installation of software on operational systems
clauses.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems
clauses.helpText: Change management and software deployment procedures

clauses.title: Networks security
clauses.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications
clauses.helpText: Network security architecture, firewalls, and network access controls

clauses.title: Security of network services
clauses.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored
clauses.helpText: Network service agreements and security requirements

clauses.title: Segregation of networks
clauses.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks
clauses.helpText: Network segmentation, VLANs, and DMZ architecture

clauses.title: Web filtering
clauses.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content
clauses.helpText: Web filtering, URL categorization, and content filtering policies

clauses.title: Use of cryptography
clauses.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented
clauses.helpText: Encryption policy, key management, and cryptographic standards

clauses.title: Secure development life cycle
clauses.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied
clauses.helpText: SDL/SDLC with security gates, security requirements in development

clauses.title: Application security requirements
clauses.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications
clauses.helpText: Security requirements gathering and specification in projects

clauses.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
clauses.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities
clauses.helpText: Secure architecture principles: defense in depth, zero trust, least privilege

clauses.title: Secure coding
clauses.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development
clauses.helpText: Secure coding standards (OWASP), code review, and static analysis

clauses.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
clauses.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle
clauses.helpText: Penetration testing, SAST, DAST, and security acceptance criteria

clauses.title: Outsourced development
clauses.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development
clauses.helpText: Vendor management, code escrow, and security requirements for outsourced development

clauses.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
clauses.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured
clauses.helpText: Environment separation, data masking in non-production, and access controls

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures
clauses.helpText: Change management process, approval workflows, and rollback procedures

clauses.title: Test information
clauses.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed
clauses.helpText: Test data management, anonymization, and production data usage controls

clauses.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
clauses.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management
clauses.helpText: Audit testing procedures with minimal impact on production systems
